author: Oliver Issing
text: You cannot trust your CGM system all the time. This is a general issue with it. In addition, I am worried if people let their CAPM algorithm do its work based on wrong values given by the CGM. Keep that in mind!

author: Barrie Linch
text: No surprises there. It updates every minute but that doesn't mean you should be checking it every minute. There are many ups and downs, if it's updated once a minute and some of the ups and downs are 'ironed out' over a slightly longer period to allow for the fact that the individual anomalies wouldn't be representative of the trend. Maybe it would be more helpful to you if you checked it slightly less often. As you say, you hate it when it happens so simply avoid it. I think they should only update every 5 minutes, as used to be the case. It's great to be able to see what our levels are but let's not drive ourselves mad!
